text: {"lessons":["I sold early positions for modest gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should use a consistent plan for each holding.","After buying larger positions in Period 6, I held through substantial losses; I should consider portfolio risk and position size before buying, not let loss aversion keep me from reassessing.","With prices unpredictable and no trades in the later periods, I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and make deliberate decisions based on my overall plan."]}
